description: Found in the fz-88t design pass (2026-07-15). collect_resume_entries (jobs/transport.rs:2656-2701) builds deliver_callsites: HashMap<target_entry, CallSiteId> via plain .insert() -- two DIFFERENT callsites delivering into the same target entry = whichever iterates last silently wins, and only that callsites classification feeds ResumeEntry::callsite. Does not corrupt the fz-88t fix (the component OR-join independently folds every positions carrier requirement) but is a latent arbitrary-survivor: a case where the CHOSEN callsites classification differs from a siblings for a reason the join does not re-derive would misclassify. AUDIT + FIX: ResumeEntry.callsite -> Vec<CallSiteId> or a pre-folded any-callsite-requires-carrier bit. Same disease family as merge_callsite_activation (fixed) and the k22.13 order pins.
title: collect_resume_entries deliver_callsites: plain insert = arbitrary-survivor when two callsites deliver into one target entry
